title: Freeport event explores the science of ghosts
excerpt: Join the Paranormal Professor in Freeport to learn how science and psychology explain reports of ghosts.
content:
Oct. 6, 2026, 3:31 a.m. CT

Area residents can explore reports of ghosts, paranormal investigations and the science behind unusual experiences during an upcoming Lunch & Learn program at the Senior Resource Center in Freeport.

The presentation, “The Paranormal Professor: Exploring the Unexplained,” is scheduled for Oct. 8 from noon to 1 p.m., according to a community announcement.

The free event will feature Joel Ramsey, known as the Paranormal Professor, discussing paranormal experiences and the people who report them.

Ramsey will examine unexplained events through examples and case studies while exploring how paranormal investigative techniques intersect with research on perception, communication and psychology. The program also will address how people interpret extraordinary experiences and why individuals can have different reactions to the same event.

Attendees will learn about methods used to gather and assess evidence as well as the role personal experiences play in reports of paranormal activity.

Exploring the paranormal through research

Ramsey is a certified paranormal investigator who holds a Ph.D. and has worked as a university lecturer and researcher. According to the announcement, Ramsey draws on academic experience in communication studies, including rhetoric and cybernetics, while studying reports of paranormal phenomena.

The presentation is designed to combine discussion of investigative approaches with stories about unexplained events. According to the announcement, Ramsey's work focuses on examining claims and historical mysteries through both research and field investigations.

Organizers said Ramsey also plans to give a separate presentation in Galena in November. Details about that event have not yet been announced.

Event details

The Lunch & Learn program is free, though registration is encouraged because seating is limited.

Participants may bring a sack lunch to eat during the presentation.

The event will take place at the Senior Resource Center, 206 E. Stephenson St., Freeport. For more information, call 815-235-9777.
